raw.details:
About the Event

Hackosquad CTF is a 24-hour online Capture The Flag competition hosted by hackosquad. It is the final chapter of our Marvel-inspired CTF series, following the Iron Man and Spider-Man editions. Doctor Doom has taken over global systems and set a Doomsday countdown. You play the resistance, breaking into his networks, decoding his secrets and shutting down his plan before time runs out.

The challenges are released in phases and get harder as the event goes on. Beginners will find plenty to solve, and experienced players will find a serious final challenge.

Event Details

  • Start: 1 November 2026
  • End: 2 November 2026
  • Duration: 24 hours
  • Mode: Online
  • Participation: Solo

Prizes worth Rs 50,000+

  • Winner: EvoFox Mechanical Keyboard
  • First runner-up: EvoFox Phantom 2 Programmable ARGB Gaming Mouse
  • Second runner-up: Ant Esports Ninja Extended Gaming Mouse Pad
  • Top 50: 3-month Uplearn voucher (Rs 999 value each)
  • Everyone who participates: certificate

Who Can Participate:

  • Open to school and college students, working professionals and cybersecurity enthusiasts. No prior CTF experience is needed.
